title: Preserve native obligation dependencies in historical evidence exchange
outcome: Valid native binding-obligation triggers and imported-consumption satisfaction evidence can be captured, transported and retained with exact typed original provenance.
acceptance: Typed dependency inventory recognizes actual native binding WorkEvent triggers using the shared rule classification and admits ImportedConsumption satisfaction only in the valid decision context, while preserving observation-only source rules, registered-input evidence constraints and existing semantic validation.

Behavioral cases use actual native obligation and imported-consumption producers, then capture/export/encode/read/plan/retain their complete closure with unchanged original ids, kinds, bytes and origins; malformed or missing required dependency kinds refuse atomically, and foreign records remain inert.

The author records durable/projection impact and delivers a complete exact-source focused-check package from a separately claimed named worktree, preserving the parent freeze and the earlier disclosure candidate's pending checks.

completion.summary: Native binding obligation triggers and imported-consumption satisfaction preserve typed original dependencies through capture and evidence exchange, with rule and registered-input constraints intact.
